title: Quantitative Electroluminescence Imaging Analysis for Performance Estimation of PID-Influenced PV Modules
mechanism: Camera and perspective correction, then power-loss map from the log ratio of two EL images (before / after degradation or two currents).
evidence: R: about 2000 EL images and I-V curves, relative RMSE 1 to 3% against flash test.
adaptation: Single-bias data, so no score use; physics basis for converting dark / inactive area into a power-loss band, and for any future two-current capture on WattCycle's rig.
min_experiment: No training: only if two-current images become available; otherwise use as a reference for the severity metric.
